SWZ.note: Document states no rule, draft or authority on AI harms.
Only the revenue authority's tax-audit AI is named, which is a sector system, and only as a plan.
The revenue service only says it will pilot AI risk models for tax returns; a pledge, no pilot stated as running.
No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in Eswatini is stated.
Only a planned no-stop border with SARS and an AEO accreditation programme are stated; no customs system or declaration processing is described.
Document is a revenue authority's 12-month plan, not a national digital strategy.
Only plans for e-invoicing and integrated tax and duty payments are stated; no electronic payment in service or contracted is stated.
